mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( account_name, account_status, account_type, current_balance, data_as_of_at, external_account_key, maturity_at, opened_at, connection_id, org_code ) VALUES ( #{accountName}, #{accountStatus}, #{accountType}, #{currentBalance}, #{dataAsOfAt}, #{externalAccountKey}, #{maturityAt}, #{openedAt}, #{connectionId}, #{orgCode} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE org_code = VALUES(org_code), account_name = VALUES(account_name), account_status = VALUES(account_status), account_type = VALUES(account_type), current_balance = VALUES(current_balance), data_as_of_at = VALUES(data_as_of_at), maturity_at = VALUES(maturity_at), opened_at = VALUES(opened_at)

INSERT INTO account_transaction ( amount, balance_after, category_code, description, external_transaction_id, merchant_name, transaction_at, transaction_type, account_id ) SELECT #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{categoryCode}, #{description}, #{externalTransactionId}, #{merchantName}, #{transactionAt}, #{transactionType}, #{accountId} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_transaction WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND external_transaction_id = #{externalTransactionId} )
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, external_account_key, account_type, account_name, current_balance, account_status, opened_at, maturity_at, data_as_of_at, updated_at, connection_id, org_code FROM account WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} ORDER BY account_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT org_code FROM account WHERE connection_id = #{connectionId} AND org_code IS NOT NULL
